title: Easy Elegant British Sausages Toad In The Hole
description: A classic British dish featuring sausages cooked in a light and airy yeast batter, perfect for a festive meal. This recipe is gluten-free friendly and uses ground sugar and brine-wet ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, sugar, and yeast.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and brine.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Place the sausages in a large baking dish.
Pour the batter over the sausages, making sure they are fully covered.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the batter is golden brown and the sausages are cooked through.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
